# registry_module_version_deprecation (Resource)

Marks a specific module version as deprecated. Destroying this resource removes the deprecation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "registry_module_version_deprecation" "vpc_1_0_0" {
  namespace          = "my-org"
  name               = "vpc"
  system             = "aws"
  version            = "1.0.0"
  message            = "1.0.0 creates public subnets by default; upgrade to 1.2.0 or later."
  replacement_source = "registry.example.com/my-org/vpc/aws"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `message` (String) Deprecation message shown to users.
- `name` (String) Module name.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace (organization name) owning the module.
- `system` (String) Module system (provider name, e.g. 'aws').
- `version` (String) Semantic version string of the module version to deprecate.

### Optional

- `replacement_source` (String) Optional replacement source address (used by Terraform CLI ≥1.10 for upgrade guidance).

### Read-Only

- `deprecated_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the version was deprecated.
